name: create-image
description: Pika take-home: Create Image app (React + Vite frontend, FastAPI backend, mocked async model)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && uv --directory backend sync
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run uvicorn --factory app.main:create_app --reload --reload-dir app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 3
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.setup:e2e: npm --prefix e2e install && npm --prefix e2e run install-browser
